description: This header file declares functions related to listing repository references in a version control system, possibly Git. It includes function prototypes for listing references and advertising them, along with forward declarations of related structures.

methods.name: ls_refs
methods.description: Function to list references from a repository, taking a repository object and a request object.

methods.name: ls_refs_advertise
methods.description: Function to advertise references for a repository, taking a repository object and a string buffer.
